ops.title: Hooks skip on long transcripts: per-dispatch budgets vs whole-file snapshot loads
ops.body:
Observed 2026-10-01 in a long-running root session (900424b6, root transcript 78-83 MB, 100+ teammate lanes), on capt-hook 12.67.1.

Budgets (before the trailing-window change, captain_hook/snapshots/client.py:33-38 at d216bb32):
- Tool events: 1 MiB source reads (GRAPH_SOURCE_READ_BYTES) and 0.75 s (GRAPH_WORK_SECONDS) per dispatch.
- Stop / SubagentStop / UserPromptSubmit: 8 MiB (GATE_SOURCE_READ_BYTES) and 5 s.
- Foreground logical reads over in-memory snapshots: 64 MiB (FOREGROUND_READ_BYTES).
- Enforced in SnapshotClient.call (client.py:301 deadline, :318 byte budget); EvidenceIncomplete is fail-open (client.py:109), so dispatch.py:262-266 skips the hook and note_evidence_gap (dispatch.py:141) logged one warning per hook per call. worker/fail_open.py tallied dispatches and warned at 3 and each doubling.
- MAX_TRANSCRIPT_BYTES (transcripts.py, 256 MiB) only bounds registered external transcripts, not hook evidence.

Skip reasons, last 4000 log lines of that session (~50 min): byte budget exhausted 1684, deadline exhausted 941, "classifier read budget exhausted before callback" 581, read_limit 280, snapshot transport deadline 199, cancelled 126. Mostly nudges and LLM gates; block hooks included landing_state_through_ccx (304) and graphite.vcs:hook_5c99213c (12).

Repro: a static 83 MB copy of the root transcript, PreToolUse Bash through the real 12.67.1 host (plugin bin/hook): 11/11 dispatches over 2 minutes skipped landing_state_through_ccx (byte budget, then source_read_limit, then the 0.75 s deadline). Background warm_root never made the foreground succeed even with no appends.

Root cause, in cc-transcript's snapshot engine (rust/crates/core/src/snapshot.rs at e6bc997):
- acquire parses the source from byte 0 (Load { offset: 0 }, snapshot.rs:3640); appends reuse the previous snapshot through the prefix fence (snapshot.rs:4103-4160), but a cold load of tens of MB never fits a dispatch.
- Non-native classifiers (captain-lane for every subagent/teammate transcript, captain-conductor; chosen in captain_hook/snapshots/worker.py:148-165) are prepared per snapshot id from event 0 (ClassifierSlot keyed by snapshot.id, indexed: 0, snapshot.rs:1810-1870; LabelPreparation, snapshot.rs:1516-1600), so every append re-labels the whole lane transcript through the Python callback.

Decision (owner): hook evidence reads a bounded trailing window, never the whole file; the size cap and the skip/tally path are deleted rather than raised. cc-transcript task #87 adds tail_bytes / tail_events windows and carries classifier stages across appends; captain-hook sends the window from hook clients only (reviewer and mining stay whole-file) and names each skipped hook once per session.
